(1) Admin Wallets Modal: editing SYP→500000 / USD→5000 / TRY→20000 now displays '500,000' / '5,000' / '20,000' immediately in [data-testid=admin-wallet-amt-<CUR>] while the modal is still open. (2) Post-exchange redirect: after typing 50 in exchange (USD→SYP) → confirm-ok → auto-redirect to /app/home, wallet-USD renders '50$' and wallet-SYP renders '650,000ل.س' without any manual reload. All previously-passing behaviors still work: admin exchange log shows 'Exchange Test User' with -50 USD / +650,000 SYP, admin's own wallets updated correctly (USD 5,050 / SYP 9,350,000 / TRY 20,000), user's transactions list shows the exchange row with label 'عملية صرف' and no admin counterparty name leaked. 100% of the 2 blocking bugs + 4 regression assertions now pass.

fix_verification.AuthContext.jsx refreshCurrent(): Confirmed exposed via useAuth() and correctly re-hydrates `current` from AUTH_KEY.
fix_verification.AdminPanel.jsx refresh(): Confirmed calls refreshCurrent() + tick++; wallet amt updates immediately while modal open.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct. `refreshCurrent()` cleanly re-reads AUTH_KEY into React state — better than the previous `updateUser({})` empty-patch code smell.

Note: setAdminWallet() and executeExchange() still directly mutate localStorage from outside the React component tree — they rely on callers to invoke refreshCurrent() afterward. This is acceptable for the mock-backend era but should be migrated to context methods (or a real backend) so state consistency isn't caller-dependent. Not blocking.
AppExchange.jsx L135 still uses useMemo(() => getRates(), []) — rates don't react to admin editing while the exchange screen is open. Same note as iteration 3; not caused by this fix.

In an over-liquid scenario the admin SYP wallet CAN go negative when a user sells foreign currency (verified: after seeding SYP=500K in iteration 3 test, the exchange failed via insufficient_admin_liquidity — the guard works). Considered semantically fine for mock. No fix needed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both HIGH-priority React state-refresh bugs from iteration 3 are FIXED and stayed fixed across full end-to-end retest. Fix approach: AuthProvider exposes refreshCurrent() → AdminPanel.refresh() calls it after each save → AppExchange.doExchange() calls it before navigating back. No new regressions. If future changes touch AuthContext direct-localStorage mutators (setAdminWallet, executeExchange), the same refreshCurrent() pattern must be applied by callers or the mutators should be moved inside the provider. Consider a lint/test to enforce.
rca_of_the_issue: Both bugs were caused by direct-localStorage mutators (setAdminWallet, executeExchange) writing AUTH_KEY without notifying the React AuthProvider's `current` useState. Fix — exposing refreshCurrent() from AuthProvider and calling it from AdminPanel (post-save) and AppExchange (pre-navigate) — cleanly re-hydrates state. Verified via full flow: pre-state → mutation → immediate readback of data-testid values matches expected + localStorage.
